script:
Murder Mystery Character Profiles - English Translation
Zhou Ming
Zhou Ming, 45 years old, businessman. Due to greed, you leaked your business partner Su's commercial secrets, causing him to nearly lose everything. Of course, you couldn't do this alone - you're naturally cowardly. Your ex-wife Liu the tour guide was the mastermind behind it all.
Later, Liu the tour guide hit someone while driving without a license. She threatened to expose your commercial secret leak to the world and made you take the blame as a scapegoat. She also divorced you to protect her financial interests and escape punishment and compensation for the car accident.
Although you're not exactly an upright person, you still regret the mistakes you made. "Those who commit many wrongs will destroy themselves" - you never expected your closest wife to make you taste the bitter fruit. Liu the tour guide constantly threatens and suppresses you, making you restless. You've tried to talk to Liu several times, but she actually refuses to speak with you. If this continues and the truth comes out, not only will you go to prison, but your hard-built career will also go up in smoke. For this reason, you've developed murderous intent. You think that murder can be concealed, but this woman full of trouble will sooner or later ruin your reputation.
Lin Keke is your pursuer. After learning you were married, she didn't disturb you. After your divorce, she came to find you and learned about the car accident. She wholeheartedly wants to seek justice for you, but you have no feelings for her and don't want to burden her, so you didn't say much.
Liu the tour guide is responsible for UK outbound tours. You bribed contacts at the hotel you're about to stay at, having the staff tamper with Liu's room door lock. Although swiping the room card shows a response, you can turn the handle and enter without swiping the card. If communication fails again, you're prepared to sneak into the room and kill her. Since Liu has long been staying in hotels, swiping room cards has become a habit, making it difficult for her to notice the broken lock. Even if she discovers it, it can't be traced back to you.
Your Timeline:

October 12, 7:00 PM: Arrived at the hotel. Tried to talk to Liu again but was refused. Then went to the lobby to listen to Su Ning play piano and arranged to meet Lin Keke tonight.
October 12, 8:30 PM: Returned to room to pack.
October 12, 9:00 PM: Met and talked with Lin Keke. She said she wanted to find Liu for you. Although you know Lin Keke loves you, you don't want unrelated people involved, so you refused and just vented your troubles. After chatting for half an hour, you both returned to your rooms.
October 13, 2:00 AM: You received a text from Lin Keke saying she went to find Liu and was mistreated. You finally couldn't tolerate Liu's behavior anymore.
October 13, 3:55 AM: You went to her room and opened the door. You found Liu lying on the bed but awake, and she noticed you. You felt she was very weak. You pressed her about what exactly she wanted, saying a lot, but she had no reaction, just mumbling: "Don't bother me, get lost, everyone get lost." In anger, you took out the prepared fishing line and strangled Liu's neck. However, to your surprise, Liu didn't resist at all, didn't even make a sound. When you let go to check, you found she was already dead. It couldn't have been you who killed her - you barely used any force. You were scared and fled back to your room, arriving around 4:20 AM.

Bai Duyun
Bai Duyun, 22 years old, medical student. Excellent grades, handsome appearance, university heartthrob, girlfriend is Su Ning. In others' eyes, you're like a prince. You once became an internet celebrity "school uniform prince" because photos of you in school uniform went viral online.
But actually, your family's financial situation is very difficult. You always wear school uniforms because you have no money for other clothes. You love traveling but can only go on budget bike trips. Until you met Su Ning, who loves you very much and invites you on trips. You feel ashamed, so you take care of her meticulously. Eventually, you confirmed your romantic relationship. You vowed to study hard, save money, and treat her better.
Unexpectedly, three months ago, a car accident changed everything. Your father was hit by a car and became a vegetable. Your already poor family fell into debt due to medical expenses. The perpetrator Zhou Ming only gave a symbolic compensation of a few thousand yuan and didn't pay the 500,000 yuan medical fees he was responsible for. The pain of losing a family member, family breakdown, and financial loss couldn't be compensated at all.
Later you investigated and found that the actual perpetrator was Zhou Ming's wife Liu, who was even driving without a license at the time. Later, the two used money to settle the matter and switched the perpetrator to Zhou, allowing Liu to escape prison. Soon after, the two divorced. Your family is powerless - father is a vegetable, mother's health is poor. You suddenly felt your future was bleak and life hopeless.
You used savings from long-term part-time work to hire a private detective and finally learned that Liu and Zhou's divorce was also a means to escape punishment and compensation. Moreover, Liu threatened Zhou, saying she would expose Zhou's commercial leak to the world, coercing Zhou to take the blame for her. You don't know what commercial secrets these were - the detective said this intelligence required additional fees, but you weren't interested and had no money to pay.
After learning Liu still worked at a travel company handling UK outbound tours, you specifically borrowed money from friends as your own savings to apply for a visa, maxed out credit cards for travel expenses, and came to settle accounts with Liu. Traveling alone would easily arouse suspicion, so you used your girlfriend's upcoming study in the UK as an excuse to bring her to the UK together. In the tour group, you not only saw Liu the tour guide but also met her ex-husband Zhou Ming. You only want to confront Liu about what happened back then, to question this murderer who nearly destroyed your family.
Although you and Su Ning have been together for a long time, you haven't reached that step yet, so you're not staying in the same room during this trip.
Your Timeline:

October 12, 7:00 PM: Arrived in the UK, checked into the hotel. Girlfriend Su Ning was playing piano. You carried her luggage to her room and settled your own luggage. Finally got this opportunity, so you decided to settle things tonight.
October 12, 8:00 PM: You saw Liu leave her room, so you tried turning her door handle. Unexpectedly, the door opened, so you entered Liu's room. Then you put sleeping pills in Liu's water cup. Later returned to Su Ning's room to wait for her. You took out the sleeping pills, thinking about the upcoming revenge plan, and became lost in thought. At this moment, Su Ning suddenly returned. Instinctively, you threw the sleeping pills into the drawer and closed it.
October 12, 10:00 PM: You returned to your own room and realized you forgot to take the sleeping pills with you. You'll find a chance to get them back later.
October 13, 12:30 AM: You thought the sleeping pills should have taken effect, so you got up and went to Liu's room. Her room was still unlocked, you pushed the door open, but unexpectedly the sleeping pills weren't effective enough - Liu woke up from her sleep. You revealed your identity and confronted her, threatening that if she didn't admit her crimes and take responsibility, you'd die together with her. You two started arguing, and Liu went crazy and bit your hand. You couldn't break free. With your rich medical knowledge accumulated during this period for revenge, you seized the opportunity and kneed her hard in the left upper abdomen. She painfully clutched her stomach, released her bite, and fell down. With this knee strike, you were basically certain it would cause her spleen to rupture and internal bleeding leading to death. She wouldn't even realize the severity of the situation. In this foreign country with difficult medical access, she would definitely miss the optimal treatment time (would actually die in about 3-4 hours). Moreover, even if she didn't die, she wouldn't say you did it - after all, she has a guilty conscience.

(The bite marks on your hand are very deep. You should consider whether you need to lie about this wound. Here's a reason: you've had epilepsy since childhood. You had an episode that night, and during episodes you easily bite your tongue, so you put your hand in your mouth to prevent this. Epilepsy is a condition you actually have, but because you've been taking medication, you haven't had an episode in a long time, so nobody knows. You kneed her hard - this was definitely a fatal injury. Never admit it!)

October 13, 5:00 AM: Su Ning knocked on your door. You quickly pretended you hadn't woken up yet. Su Ning said she had a nightmare, so you two watched TV together until dawn.

Su Ning
You are Su Ning, 21 years old, university student.
You're beautiful with a wealthy family background. Your parents are both businesspeople. You've been raised in luxury since childhood but aren't spoiled. You have great piano talent, studying piano at university, dreaming of becoming a performer. In others' eyes, you're innocent, cute, enthusiastic, and generous with many friends. You've also captured the heart of university heartthrob Bai Duyun. You've been dating for over a year. Although his family background is ordinary, your relationship is very good. Because you're expected to study for a master's degree in the UK after undergraduate graduation, you came to the UK to travel with boyfriend Bai Duyun.
But in fact, you're not that innocent. Although your parents protected you well, you still witnessed business intrigue from a young age. Three years ago, your father's business partner Zhou Ming betrayed their agreement and sold commercial secrets, gaining massive profits from this. Your family's enterprise encountered a major crisis. Your mother even developed depression and ended her own life. But you haven't told anyone, not even boyfriend Bai Duyun, choosing instead to use your own power to change your family's situation.
Due to declining family conditions, your dream of studying abroad may be difficult to realize. But your uninformed boyfriend strongly insisted on accompanying you to the UK. You had no reason to refuse and could only agree, also taking the opportunity to relax. All the travel preparations were done by Bai Duyun, so you only discovered when the tour group gathered in Beijing that Liu the tour guide was actually Zhou Ming's wife (she doesn't recognize you, and you didn't know Liu and Zhou were divorced at the time). You know directly confronting Zhou Ming definitely won't get you any information. Starting with his wife might be a good idea - see if you can get something out of her. During the journey, you often approached Liu, chatting with her about her family matters and secretly recording, but she never gave you direct answers.
Although you and Bai Duyun have been together for a long time, you haven't reached that step yet, so you're not staying in the same room during this trip.
Your Timeline:

October 12, 7:00 PM: Entered the hotel with everyone. Bai Duyun helped you get the room card and carried luggage to your room. You played piano in the hotel lobby, and onlookers applauded.
(Information you can temporarily conceal: After the crowd dispersed, you secretly removed a piano wire when hotel staff weren't paying attention, because you plan to confront Liu and Zhou later and want to be prepared.)
October 12, 9:30 PM: Returned to your room. In the hallway, you saw Lin Keke and Zhou Ming talking. They seemed familiar, and Lin Keke was very emotional. Afraid of being discovered by Zhou Ming, you hid to the side. Bai Duyun was waiting for you in the room. You looked at photos taken today together and chatted. Bai Duyun returned to his own room at 10:00 PM.
October 13, 3:00 AM: You woke up from a nightmare and vaguely heard footsteps outside the door, making it even harder to sleep. You got up and saw your mother's photo. Grief welled up from your heart, so you decided to confront the tour guide tonight and made corresponding plans.
October 13, 4:00 AM: You set out for the tour guide's room. Just as you were about to knock, you heard voices inside, so you turned and went back.
October 13, 5:00 AM: You went to Liu's room again, knocked on the door, but no one answered. You tried turning the door handle and found it could actually open. You walked in - it was very dark inside, you could only vaguely see Liu lying on the bed, so quiet there wasn't even breathing sounds. You moved closer to look and found Liu lying on the bed, already dead.

Lin Keke
You are a 30-year-old female PhD, a promising young university teacher. Bai Duyun is a student in your college. Because he's the campus heartthrob, you've heard of him early on, though he probably doesn't know you. You know he received poverty financial aid but are puzzled why he always has money to travel everywhere. Since you're in the same tour group this time, curious you can investigate.
However, this isn't your real reason for this trip. You're unmarried. You met Zhou Ming at a gathering and were captivated by his deep gaze. Plus he's successful in business, so you fell for him. Learning he was married was very disappointing, but you still followed his situation. Recently you learned he got divorced and thought you had a chance. But you heard he was framed by his ex-wife and might face imprisonment. So you joined his ex-wife Liu's tour group, wanting to find dirt on Liu for Zhou Ming's sake, to make Liu face justice. But you unexpectedly discovered Zhou Ming was also in the tour group.
Your Timeline:

October 12, 7:00 PM: Arrived at the hotel. After settling luggage, went to the lobby to listen to Su Ning play piano.
October 12, 9:00 PM: You returned to your room and met Zhou Ming in the hallway. You said you wanted to get revenge on Liu for him, but he wouldn't let you do that. You comforted each other for a long time. After half an hour, you and Zhou Ming parted ways and returned to your room.
October 13, 1:40 AM: You came to Liu's room. You instinctively tried turning the door handle, thinking it wouldn't work, but found it could open. You entered - Liu was sitting on the bedside looking somewhat haggard. You told her why you came and couldn't help arguing with her. Only then did you realize she was a shrew. She cursed that none of you would have a good time, grabbed scissors and cut your arm. You seized the scissors and wrestled with her, but you didn't want to kill her and didn't dare use the scissors. During the struggle, you pulled out a lot of her hair before knocking her down and leaving. She seemed a bit tired, cursed at you a few times, but didn't chase after you.
October 13, 2:00 AM: After what just happened, you returned to your room and sent Zhou Ming a text message, then fell asleep anxiously.
acts_goal: You are not the murderer, please clear your name.
